answer: A sybil-resistant economy can require human-tempo proof: each identity must answer fresh prompts at a human pace, with the irregular pauses of a real operator reading and thinking, never instant and never metronomic. A farm steering a thousand puppets cannot fake a thousand distinct rhythms — its answers arrive too fast or march in lockstep, like a sonnet read by a machine that never needs to wander for the next line, while a saffron thread of delay betrays the single hand behind them.
